plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for LANCOM router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2356).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the LANCOM LCOS router (lcsStatusHardwareInfoCpuLoadPercent) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, VPN/session churn, or abnormal traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total physical memory of the LANCOM LCOS router (lcsStatusHardwareInfoTotalMemoryKbytes). The raw OID is in kilobytes and is scaled by 1024 to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free physical memory of the LANCOM LCOS router (lcsStatusHardwareInfoFreeMemoryKbytes). The raw OID is in kilobytes and is scaled by 1024 to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the LANCOM LCOS router, computed as (total - free) / total * 100. The kilobyte units cancel, so the ratio is exact.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Hardware temperature of the LANCOM router in degrees Celsius (LCOS-MIB lcsStatusHardwareInfoTemperatureDegrees).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
